rules.statement: A statute is presumed not to operate retrospectively so as to affect vested rights, and courts would always lean in favor of that interpretation which leaves vested rights unaffected.
rules.supporting_quote: "The general principle is of course that statutes are presumed not to operate retrospectively so as to affect vested rights, and that courts would always lean in favour of that interpretation which leaves vested rights unaffected [ 2 Craies statute Law, 6th ed., p. 397 ]"

meta.parties: Ram Banda v. River Valleys Development Board
